question: Is the frozen selector failing to find available physical rescues, or is the present action family itself insufficient on these new ball/body states?
analysis: Audit paired physical traces; count distinct rescue lanes available to an impossible hindsight oracle, parent success regressions under each unconditional action, and compare with frozen selector. Hindsight is diagnostic only and never a deployable actor.
decision: If oracle has at least three additional rescues beyond the frozen selector, prioritize better causal decision timing/features; otherwise prioritize new whole-body and contact-timing action support.
